description_en: Creates an agent instance and returns the channel, username, and token to join the channel

name: GenerateAIAgentCall

parameters.help_en: Optional. The expiration time of the token in seconds. Default value: 3600. Value range: 0 to 604800

parameters.name: expire

parameters.help_en: The username in the channel. If you do not specify a username, one is automatically generated. The username can be up to 64 characters in length

fields.name: enable_intelligent_segment

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable Push-to-Talk mode. Default: `false`
fields.help_zh: 是否开启对讲机模式。默认值：false
fields.name: enable_push_to_talk

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable voice interruption. Default: `true`
fields.help_zh: 是否支持语音打断，默认true

If enabled, the agent finishes its current speech (up to 10 seconds) before stopping

fields.help_zh: 启动通话后llm的系统提示词

fields.help_zh: 是否使用声纹识别的开关。默认值：false

fields.help_zh: 用户退会后，智能体超时关闭任务的时间。单位：秒。默认值：5秒
fields.name: user_offline_timeout

fields.help_zh: 用户未入会，智能体超时关闭任务的时间。单位：秒。默认值：60秒
fields.name: user_online_timeout

fields.help_en:
The interruption sensitivity threshold. A higher value makes it more difficult to interrupt the agent. Range: 0 to 11. Default: 11.

`0`: Disables VAD.

`1` to `10`: A higher value makes it more difficult to interrupt the agent.

`11`: Offers lower audio distortion and stronger resistance to interference
fields.help_zh:
打断阈值参数。取值范围：[0,11], 默认值：11。

0表示关闭 vad 功能。
1-10设置数字越高表示越难打断。
11与之前显著不同，前处理对话音损伤更低，抗干扰更强
fields.name: vad_level

fields.help_en: The ID of the Text-to-Speech (TTS) voice. Changes take effect on the next utterance. If omitted, the default voice from the agent template is used. This parameter applies only to preset TTS voices. Maximum length: 64 characters. For available values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449563.html
fields.help_zh: 音色ID，修改后下句话生效。不填写则使用智能体模版配置的音色ID。仅针对预置TTS生效。输入长度不超过64。可选值参考：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449563.html
fields.name: voice_id

fields.help_en: A list of available voices
fields.help_zh: 可选音色列表
fields.name: voice_id_list

fields.help_en: The unique ID for voiceprint recognition. Default: not specified
fields.help_zh: 声纹识别的唯一身份ID。默认值：不填
fields.name: voiceprint_id

fields.help_en:
The speaking volume of the agent.

If omitted, the system uses adaptive volume mode.

If specified, the valid range is 0 to 400. The output volume is calculated as: `Output Volume in Workflow` * (`volume`/100). For example:

If `volume` is `0`, the output is silent.

If `volume` is `100`, the output volume is the original volume.

If `volume` is `200`, the output volume is twice the original volume
fields.help_zh:
智能体说话的音量。

若不填：默认使用阿里云推荐的自适应音量模式

若填写：填写范围为0~400，输出音量=工作流中的语音输出音量 * volume/100。示例：

若volume=0，则代表输出音量为0。
 
若volume=100，音量为原声音量。

若volume=200，音量等于原声音量的2倍
fields.name: volume

Specifies whether the message history of the large model is consistent with the TTS playback content. Default value: false. After this feature is enabled, the saved large model messages are consistent with the TTS playback content.

In the message history of the large model, when the user interrupts the agent, the next message sent to the large model will insert the <ims_agent_interrupted> tag at the interruption position. Example:

```
[
  {"role": "user", "content": "Tell me a story."},
  {"role": "assistant", "content": "Sure, let me tell you a story about Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Do you<ims_agent_interrupted> want to listen?"},
  {"role": "user", "content": "Change to another one."}
]
```

```
[
  {"role": "user", "content": "给我讲一个故事。"},
  {"role": "assistant", "content": "好的，我给你讲一个三国演义的故事吧，你<ims_agent_interrupted>想听吗？"},
  {"role": "user", "content": "换一个吧。"}
]
```

fields.help_en:
The eagerness level. This parameter takes effect only in Semantic mode. It controls the speed at which the AI initiates a response after detecting a pause:
"Low": Patient waiting. The maximum waiting time is 6 seconds, which reduces the risk of being interrupted.
"Medium": Balanced waiting. The maximum waiting time is 4 seconds, which is suitable for most scenarios.
"High": Fast response. The maximum waiting time is 2 seconds, which improves speed but may increase the risk of false cuts.

Default value: empty
fields.help_zh:
仅在 Semantic 模式下生效。控制 AI 检测到停顿后，启动回应的快慢程度：
"Low"：耐心等待，最长等待时间6秒，减少被打断风险。
"Medium"：平衡等待（最长等待时间4秒），适用大多数场景。
"High"：快速响应（最长等待时间2秒），提升速度但可能增加误切风险。

字段默认空
fields.name: eagerness

fields.help_en:
The turn detection mode.

Semantic: Semantic mode. AI is used to determine whether the user has finished speaking based on the context semantics

轮次检测的模式。

Semantic：用AI根据上下文语义，判断是否说完话了

fields.help_en:

-1: AI automatically determines the appropriate waiting time.

0 to 10000: Custom waiting time. We recommend that you set it to 0 to 1500 milliseconds.

This parameter is invalid in normal mode
fields.help_zh:
AI模式下的停顿判定时间，单位:毫秒，默认值-1。

-1: AI自动判断合适的等待时间

0-10000: 自定义等待时间，建议设置在0-1500ms

普通模式下此项无效

The voiceprint registration mode. Default value: Explicit.

  | Value | Description |
  |------|------|

  | Implicit | Implicit registration mode. The user's voice is automatically collected during the conversation to generate voiceprint features. |

声纹注册模式。  默认值：Explicit

fields.help_en:
The volume of the agent's speech.

If left empty: The adaptive volume mode recommended by Alibaba Cloud is used by default.

If specified: The valid range is 0 to 400. Output volume = Voice output volume in the workflow × volume / 100. Examples:
If volume=0, the output volume is 0.

If volume=100, the volume is the original volume.

If volume=200, the volume is twice the original volume
fields.help_zh:
智能体说话的音量。

若不填：默认使用阿里云推荐的自适应音量模式

若填写：填写范围为 0~400，输出音量=工作流中的语音输出音量 * volume/100。示例：
若 volume=0，则代表输出音量为 0。

若 volume=100，音量为原声音量。

若 volume=200，音量等于原声音量的 2 倍

parameters.help_en:
The agent template configuration. The configuration you provide merges with the agent template configuration in the console. If you omit this parameter, the agent uses the default configuration from the console.

Compatibility with `TemplateConfig`: Fields in `AgentConfig` take precedence. If a field is specified in `TemplateConfig` but not in `AgentConfig`, the system uses the value from `TemplateConfig`. We recommend using `AgentConfig` instead of `TemplateConfig`

兼容TemplateConfig规则：优先使用AgentConfig中的字段，如果TemplateConfig存在某些字段AgentConfig未填写，会使用TemplateConfig字段。推荐使用AgentConfig，不再使用TemplateConfig
